events.title: Independent project adapts EmbeddingGemma 2 for speech transcription
events.title_zh: 独立项目把 EmbeddingGemma 2 改造成语音转写模型
events.summary: An independent macOS project adapts EmbeddingGemma 2's audio encoder for speech transcription by training a small reader and punctuation model. The project reports roughly 5% word error rate and one hour of audio processed in about 13 seconds on a base MacBook Air. It distributes a free app, but no reproducible training code, test set or independent comparison is exposed.

It distributes a free app, but no reproducible training code, test set or independent comparison is exposed.

events.title: NVIDIA opens the full Run:ai GPU orchestration platform
events.title_zh: NVIDIA 开源完整 Run:ai GPU 编排平台
events.summary: NVIDIA has released the full Run:ai GPU orchestration platform under Apache 2.0, including its control plane, cluster services, installer, CLI and MCP server. The repository combines the KAI Scheduler, GPU Fractioning Operator, KAI Resource Management and Workload Map. The community build is self-supported; NVIDIA's NGC distribution remains subject to NVIDIA terms.

events.title: Liquid AI releases the LFM2.5-24B-A2B reasoning model
events.title_zh: Liquid AI 发布 LFM2.5-24B-A2B 推理模型
events.summary: Liquid AI released base and post-trained weights for LFM2.5-24B-A2B, a 24B-parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates 2B parameters per token. It targets reasoning and tool use across local devices and servers, with day-one support in llama.cpp, MLX, vLLM, SGLang and ONNX. The custom license permits many commercial uses but excludes entities with at least $10 million in annual revenue unless separately licensed.
events.summary_en: Liquid AI released base and post-trained weights for LFM2.5-24B-A2B, a 24B-parameter mixture-of-experts model that activates 2B parameters per token. It targets reasoning and tool use across local devices and servers, with day-one support in llama.cpp, MLX, vLLM, SGLang and ONNX. The custom license permits many commercial uses but excludes entities with at least $10 million in annual revenue unless separately licensed.
events.summary_zh: Liquid AI 发布 LFM2.5-24B-A2B 的 base 与 post-trained 权重。该 MoE 模型总参数 24B，每个 token 激活 2B，面向本地设备与服务器上的推理和工具调用，并首日支持 llama.cpp、MLX、vLLM、SGLang 与 ONNX。自定义许可允许许多商业用途，但年收入达到 1000 万美元的主体需另行授权。
events.why_it_matters: The model offers a testable route to stronger local agent inference without activating all 24B parameters, but vendor benchmarks and the revenue-gated license limit immediate production use. Compare it on your own tool schemas, latency and memory budget before committing.
events.why_it_matters_en: The model offers a testable route to stronger local agent inference without activating all 24B parameters, but vendor benchmarks and the revenue-gated license limit immediate production use. Compare it on your own tool schemas, latency and memory budget before committing.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对做本地 agent 的团队来说，它提供了一条不必激活全部 24B 参数的推理路径。但性能数字来自厂商，自定义许可又设有营收门槛，上生产前仍要用自己的工具 schema、延迟和内存预算验证。

events.title: DoubtLess cuts reasoning tokens with contrastive decoding
events.title_zh: DoubtLess 用对比解码减少推理 token
events.summary: DoubtLess is a training-free decoding method that asks a small model to read the same chain of thought under brief and verbose instructions, then uses the logit difference to steer a larger model. The paper reports 31% fewer reasoning tokens on Qwen3-32B across seven benchmarks without lower aggregate accuracy, plus 20% fewer thinking tokens in coding self-debug tasks. Public code is available, but the results are author-reported and the reference setup requires an 80 GB GPU.
events.summary_en: DoubtLess is a training-free decoding method that asks a small model to read the same chain of thought under brief and verbose instructions, then uses the logit difference to steer a larger model. The paper reports 31% fewer reasoning tokens on Qwen3-32B across seven benchmarks without lower aggregate accuracy, plus 20% fewer thinking tokens in coding self-debug tasks. Public code is available, but the results are author-reported and the reference setup requires an 80 GB GPU.
events.summary_zh: DoubtLess 是一种免训练的解码方法：让小模型分别按简短和详细要求读取同一段思维链，再用两次输出的 logit 差引导大模型。论文称 Qwen3-32B 在七项 benchmark 上少用 31% 推理 token，汇总准确率不降；coding 自调试任务少用 20% thinking token。代码已公开，但结果来自作者，参考配置需要一张 80 GB GPU。
events.why_it_matters: If the savings transfer to real agent workloads, teams could reduce inference cost without retraining the main model. The aggregate claim can hide per-task regressions, so a small reproducible trial should compare both task success and token use.
events.why_it_matters_en: If the savings transfer to real agent workloads, teams could reduce inference cost without retraining the main model. The aggregate claim can hide per-task regressions, so a small reproducible trial should compare both task success and token use.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对需要控制 agent 推理成本的团队来说，如果节省能迁移到真实任务，就可能不训练主模型也减少费用。但汇总结果可能掩盖单项退步，试验必须同时看任务成功率和 token。

technical_details.method: contrastive decoding from brief-versus-verbose readings by a smaller model
technical_details.paper_scope: seven reasoning benchmarks plus coding self-debug experiments
technical_details.author_results: 31% fewer Qwen3-32B reasoning tokens at unchanged aggregate accuracy; 20% fewer thinking tokens in coding self-debug tasks
technical_details.reference_setup: Linux, NVIDIA GPU, vLLM 0.29; one 80 GB GPU for Qwen3-32B plus Qwen3-0.6B

events.title: Hybrid Agent switches between latent reasoning and tool calls
events.title_zh: Hybrid Agent 在潜在推理与工具调用间切换
events.summary: Hybrid Agent lets a model switch between hidden latent reasoning and explicit text interaction when it needs tools or observations. Its HybridLink mechanism carries state across the boundary instead of restarting the reasoning trace. The authors release 8B and 14B weights, data and MIT-licensed inference code, while reporting gains across 11 benchmarks with lower token use and latency.
events.summary_en: Hybrid Agent lets a model switch between hidden latent reasoning and explicit text interaction when it needs tools or observations. Its HybridLink mechanism carries state across the boundary instead of restarting the reasoning trace. The authors release 8B and 14B weights, data and MIT-licensed inference code, while reporting gains across 11 benchmarks with lower token use and latency.
events.summary_zh: Hybrid Agent 让模型在隐藏的潜在推理和显式文本交互之间切换，需要工具或环境观察时才输出文字。HybridLink 会跨过这条边界保留状态，不必重启整段推理。作者公开 8B、14B 权重、数据和 MIT 许可的推理代码，并报告在 11 项 benchmark 上提升效果、减少 token 与延迟。
events.why_it_matters: A hybrid reasoning loop could cut visible-token cost while preserving tool use, but it changes observability and debugging assumptions. Teams should test whether the released model retains traceability and tool reliability on their own tasks before adopting the pattern.
events.why_it_matters_en: A hybrid reasoning loop could cut visible-token cost while preserving tool use, but it changes observability and debugging assumptions. Teams should test whether the released model retains traceability and tool reliability on their own tasks before adopting the pattern.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对构建工具型 agent 的团队来说，混合推理可能减少可见 token 成本，同时保留工具调用；代价是可观测性和调试方式都会变化。采用这种模式前，应验证真实任务上的可追踪性与工具可靠性。

technical_details.mechanism: HybridLink switches between latent reasoning and text interaction while carrying hybrid memory
technical_details.artifacts: public 8B and 14B weights, training data and MIT-licensed inference code
technical_details.paper_scope: 11 benchmarks covering reasoning, planning and tool interaction
technical_details.author_results: 10.4% average gain, 35.5-54.7% fewer tokens, 1.8-2.6x speedup and 2.7-3.7x lower cost
technical_details.training_cost: repository guidance lists 8-16 GPUs for SFT and 32 GPUs for RL

technical_details_zh.机制: HybridLink 在潜在推理与文本交互间切换，并携带混合记忆
technical_details_zh.公开材料: 8B、14B 权重、训练数据与 MIT 许可推理代码
technical_details_zh.论文范围: 11 项推理、规划与工具交互 benchmark
technical_details_zh.作者结果: 平均提升 10.4%，token 减少 35.5% 至 54.7%，提速 1.8 至 2.6 倍，成本降低 2.7 至 3.7 倍
technical_details_zh.训练成本: 仓库说明 SFT 需要 8 至 16 张 GPU，RL 需要 32 张 GPU

evidence.claim_en: The paper and public repository confirm HybridLink, weights, data, inference code, author benchmarks and training-resource requirements; no independent reproduction was found.

events.title: GitHub push protection now blocks exposed Anthropic API keys
events.title_zh: GitHub push protection 开始拦截 Anthropic API key
events.summary: GitHub secret scanning now recognizes Anthropic service and user API keys. Push protection blocks both key types by default in repositories where secret scanning is enabled, including eligible free public repositories. This is a generally available preventive control, not evidence that a particular repository leaked a key.
events.summary_en: GitHub secret scanning now recognizes Anthropic service and user API keys. Push protection blocks both key types by default in repositories where secret scanning is enabled, including eligible free public repositories. This is a generally available preventive control, not evidence that a particular repository leaked a key.
events.summary_zh: GitHub secret scanning 现在可以识别 Anthropic service API key 与 user API key。启用 secret scanning 的仓库会默认由 push protection 拦截这两类 key，符合条件的免费公开仓库也在覆盖范围内。这是已 GA 的预防控制，不代表某个仓库已经泄露凭据。
events.why_it_matters: Teams using Claude APIs gain a default guardrail at commit time, reducing the chance that a live credential reaches repository history. Organization owners still need to verify policy coverage and rotate any previously exposed key.
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams using Claude APIs gain a default guardrail at commit time, reducing the chance that a live credential reaches repository history. Organization owners still need to verify policy coverage and rotate any previously exposed key.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对使用 Claude API 的团队来说，提交时多了一道默认护栏，可降低有效凭据进入 Git 历史的概率。组织管理员仍要确认策略覆盖，并轮换任何已经暴露过的 key。
